purpose: Capacity planning for cardiology beds: we need to see how heart failure admissions develop over time at each hospital.
question: How many heart failure admissions did each hospital record per year?
definitions: Heart failure stay = inpatient encounter whose primary_icd10 starts with I50.
The year of a stay is the calendar year of its start_date.
Report per hospital and year (2023, 2024, 2025): number of heart failure stays.
